name: devops-exercises
description: Linux, Jenkins, AWS, SRE, Prometheus, Docker, Python, Ansible, Git, Kubernetes, Terraform, OpenStack, SQL, NoSQL, Azure, GCP, DNS, Elastic, Network, Virtualization. DevOps Interview Questions
one_liner: A giant free library of practice questions and exercises for DevOps, cloud, and SRE job interviews, covering things like Linux, AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes.
buyer: A job-seeking DevOps or SRE engineer prepping for interviews, or a bootcamp that wants ready-made curriculum content.
business_use_cases: A coding bootcamp or training company adapts the question bank as paid course curriculum instead of writing one from scratch.
A career-coaching service for engineers sells mock-interview sessions built directly on this question set.
A recruiting firm uses it to build a free DevOps skills-screening quiz that attracts candidates to their job board.

money_ideas.idea: A paid 'premium' interview-prep app layering spaced-repetition and progress tracking on top of the free question bank.
Sponsored job listings placed alongside the free study content to reach job-seeking engineers.

steal_this: Turn the questions into a simple flashcard quiz web app with a free tier and a paid 'track my progress' tier, and launch it this weekend.
